intent: Constrain generated midsummer foliage to a dry thin-dielectric optical response with measured-order refractive behavior, broad microfacet highlights, coherent two-sided normals and cause-based transmitted sunlight. This contract cannot clear the visual gate without sealed native 4K evidence.

physicalBasis.materialClass: living dry-surface plant leaf / thin dielectric lamina
physicalBasis.wetness: disabled in the dry benchmark; no generic wet sheen is permitted
physicalBasis.uvAging: small ordinary canopy exposure/value variation only; no emissive green and no painted sun highlight
physicalBasis.angularFresnelResponse: Schlick Fresnel driven by dielectric F0=0.03; specular lobe uses isotropic GGX with Schlick-Smith masking and roughness derived from the co-registered smoothness mask
physicalBasis.geometryVsMaterial: leaf/cluster silhouette, branch attachment and LOD population remain geometry; lamina micro-normal, broad dielectric specular and transmitted-light response remain material/shader detail

manufactureInstallationReasoning.assembly: natural leaf attached to explicit twig/cluster geometry
manufactureInstallationReasoning.components: twig/branch support -> leaf cluster transform -> explicit leaf lamina mesh -> co-registered albedo/normal/smoothness textures
manufactureInstallationReasoning.dimensionsThickness: leaf thickness is optically modeled as a thin lamina and is not exaggerated into visible slab thickness; branch/twig dimensions remain in tree-detail geometry metadata
manufactureInstallationReasoning.materialsFinish: non-metallic living leaf surface with dry cuticle/cell-wall dielectric response and vein-scale micro-normal structure
manufactureInstallationReasoning.mounting: leaf clusters remain parented to generated branch/twig hierarchy; optical QA must not create colliders or move gameplay geometry
manufactureInstallationReasoning.interfacesGapsSeals: no manufactured seals; required interface is a physically located branch/twig attachment with no floating leaf cluster
manufactureInstallationReasoning.orientationExposure: two-sided shading uses the viewed face normal; canopy height/radial/sun-side context drives modest exposure/transmission variation under the same SummerSun used by the sky and shadows
manufactureInstallationReasoning.aging: ordinary midsummer value variation only; damage, storm, disaster and reconstruction cues are prohibited
manufactureInstallationReasoning.lodPolicy: existing LOD0/1/2/3 leaf/cluster hierarchy remains renderer-distinct with animated cross-fade; actual shimmer/pop requires temporal render evidence

requiredBehavior: Cull Off with view-facing back-face shading normal
dielectric F0 rather than metallic/specular art scalar
GGX direct specular with Schlick-Smith masking
transmission multiplied by main-light attenuation and non-reflected dielectric energy

externalOpticalReferences.title: Refractive index of plant cell walls
externalOpticalReferences.relevance: Reports an average plant cell-wall refractive index near 1.425 across four genera; used only to anchor order-of-magnitude dielectric F0, not to claim a species-specific leaf measurement.

externalOpticalReferences.title: Refractive index of soybean leaf cell walls
externalOpticalReferences.relevance: Reports about 1.415 for fully hydrated living soybean leaf cell walls; brackets the selected visible-order F0 around 0.03.

automaticFail: claiming foliage visual quality without an actual Unity render

verification: Source and machine-readable optical constraints only. Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile plus sealed native 3840x2160 still/crop and temporal evidence remain required before any Visual Fidelity points can be awarded.
